definitions.gloss: mourning; memorial; tribute to the deceased
definitions.explanation: The act of honoring and grieving for someone who has died, typically through ceremonies, speeches, or written tributes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{故人|こじん}→故人：02807_kojin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{追悼|ついとう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{追悼|ついとう}{式|しき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{参列|さんれつ}→参列：11888_sanretsu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Many people attended the memorial ceremony.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犠牲者|ぎせいしゃ}→犠牲者：18769_giseisha⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{追悼|ついとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意|い}→意：30489_i⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{込|こ}めて→込める：01945_komeru⟧、{一分間|いっぷんかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{黙祷|もくとう}→黙祷：17408_mokutou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{捧|ささ}げられた→捧げる：02055_sasageru⟧。
examples.english: A moment of silence was observed in tribute to the victims.

notes:
A formal word used in solemn contexts to express grief and honor for someone who has passed away.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {追悼|ついとう}{式|しき} (memorial ceremony)
- {追悼|ついとう}⟦{演説|えんぜつ}→演説：01894_enzetsu⟧ (memorial speech, eulogy)
- {追悼|ついとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意|い}→意：30489_i⟧ (sentiment of mourning)
- {追悼|ついとう}{文|ぶん} (tribute, memorial essay)
- {追悼|ついとう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to mourn, to pay tribute to)

Used in news coverage of funerals, memorial events, and anniversary commemorations. More formal and public than ⟦{悲|かな}しむ→悲しむ：02042_kanashimu⟧ (to grieve) or ⟦{偲|しの}ぶ→偲ぶ：30130_shinobu⟧ (to fondly remember).
